purpose: Classify which IR metadata representation is already materialized in an exact Stage1 source so historical candidate transformers and reports cannot be reapplied to a newer representation epoch.
classification_rules: packed and explicit parameter metadata may not coexist
packed and explicit local metadata may not coexist
epoch 2 requires all four explicit parameter arrays
epoch 3 requires epoch 2 plus at least eight distinct explicit ir_local_* array lanes
ir_local_record_count is a scalar audit counter and never counts as a metadata lane
source SHA and byte count are part of the epoch identity

historical_transform_policy.packed_parameter_transform: allowed only before explicit parameter metadata exists and still subject to its own source-SHA lock
historical_transform_policy.packed_local_transform: must fail closed when explicit local lanes already exist
historical_transform_policy.legacy_static_or_native_report: stale unless its source SHA equals the exact current source SHA and its declared representation epoch equals the detected epoch

fail_closed_if: packed and explicit parameter representations coexist
only a subset of explicit parameter arrays exists
packed and explicit local representations coexist
a consumer presents an epoch report for a different source SHA
a historical transformer declares applicability to a newer detected epoch without an explicit migration contract
